faqs.a:
(a)
Annual fishing permits are available at the Arvada City Hall, Finance Department,
               8101 Ralston Road, Arvada, Colorado between 8:30 a.m. and 4:30 p.m., Monday through
               Friday. Permits are nontransferable.
(b)
For residents of the city the annual fishing permit fees are as follows: $25.00 per
               vehicle; $25.00 per boat; $15.00 per vehicle for a senior citizen or handicapped person;
               $15.00 per boat for a senior citizen or handicapped person; no cost per one vehicle
               for a Disabled American Veteran; no cost per one boat for a Disabled American Veteran.
(c)
The annual fishing permit fees for nonresidents are as follows: $35.00 per vehicle;
               $35.00 per boat; $25.00 per vehicle for a senior citizen or handicapped person; $25.00
               per boat for a senior citizen or handicapped person.
(d)
Daily fishing permits are available at the Arvada/Blunn Reservoir main entrance on
               a self-service basis during the times that the reservoir is open. Permits are nontransferable.
(e)
Daily fishing permit fees for people who wish to fish are as follows: $5.00 per motorized
               vehicle, $5.00 per boat, $3.00 per bicyclist, $3.00 per individual fisherman, and
               $3.00 per walk-in.
(f)
Annual fishing permits for second or more vehicles or boats owned by the same person
               may be purchased at 50 percent of the cost set forth in subsections (b) and (c) of
               this section but must be purchased at the same time that the original permit is purchased
               pursuant to subsections (b) and (c) of this section.
(Code 1981, § 22-27; Ord. No. 3609, §§ 1, 2, 4-3-2000;
Ord. No. 4256, § 3, 3-21-2011
)
